meta.name: Whores’ Glory
meta.description: In a visual exploration of institutionalised prostitution,Whores’ Glorytravels the globe to show how these people really live and work today, across three economically divergent countries. In Bangkok, Thailand, women punch a clock and wait for clients inside a brightly-lit glass box. In the red-light district of Faridpur, Bangladesh, a madam trafficker haggles over the price of a teenage girl. On the border town of Reynosa, Mexico, crack-addictions run high while women pray to ‘Lady Death.’Whores’ Gloryis a unobscured look at the realities of sex-trafficking today and the industry that continues to spawns it and keep it alive.
